text:
Lina: Quick heads up - new devs reported onboarding flakiness: 429 spikes when using the rust-sampleapp with default settings.
Omar: rust-sampleapp? I thought we only had js/python/go templates.
Lina: we added a community rust sample last week; defaults copied from js (prefetch=3, concurrency=12). turned out to be aggressive.
Grace: ah parity surprise. different runtime + tokio scheduler makes concurrent requests pile up differently.
Omar: logs?
Lina: paste: repeated `429 POST /v1/embeddings cursor=...` then immediate retries. also a few `401refresh` spikes.
Grace: two separate issues: (1) prefetch window too large for small infra, (2) token refresh races if client doesn't singleflight.
Omar: rust-sdk currently has no token singleflight util. js-sdk added one last quarter.
Lina: suggestion: change rust-sampleapp defaults to prefetch=1, concurrency=6; add a small token_refresh_mutex (futures-aware) in the sdk util.
Grace: also update retry behavior: use exponential backoff with full jitter on 429s. base=100ms cap=4000ms.
Omar: small dedupe trick: coalesce identical cursor fetches for 75ms using a dashmap of inflight futures. cheap and avoids duplicate RPCs.
Lina: can we also emit a debug metric `client.prefetch.requests` so QA can see fanout per signup flow?
Grace: yes, add that to sampleapp telemetry and a `--onboarding-safe` flag that flips conservative defaults.
dev-bot: created task DEVX-1124: align sdk defaults + add token singleflight for rust at 1752507800
Omar: I'll PR the rust-sampleapp defaults and add the dedupe util.
Grace: I'll implement token singleflight in rust-sdk and add unit tests that simulate concurrent refresh.
Lina: docs: add a tiny note under onboarding troubleshooting about prefetch and cursor TTL. mention `--onboarding-safe`.
Omar: timeline - PRs today, staging deploy tonight, QA run tomorrow morning.
Lina: thanks. long-term: we should audit all sampleapp templates whenever we change sdk defaults to avoid cross-language surprises.
Grace: agreed. parity wins UX.
Lina: update - after staging deploy with conservative defaults, 429s dropped ~88% in the rust onboarding run. will follow up with telemetry charts.
